placement: Guardrail — the federation envelope protocol becomes a language-neutral contract unit, contract/federation.contract.json (limen.federation, a new unit role "protocol": a wire protocol that is neither Core nor a capability, so it has no capability offer). Its TypeScript types and codec are generated into src/federation/generated/, which architecture/layers.json adds to the federation-host layer; F#, C# and Rust bindings are generated into the guest contract projects. src/federation.ts takes its wire types and FEDERATION_PROTOCOL_VERSION from the generated module instead of defining them, keeping every exported name and refining only payload to JsonValue. Runtime strict decoding in the host and migrating the F# site modules to the generated bindings are left to a follow-up, because the site's WebAssembly build cannot run in this sandbox.

expansions.reason: The decision record named the federation envelope as the open follow-up this work item closes; its note now says WI-0030 brought it under the neutral contract.
